target_customer: Outpatient therapy practices (ABA, PT, speech, OT), imaging centers and revenue cycle teams that pay for admin automation
problem: Therapy and outpatient practices lose staff time to intake, insurance verification, prior authorizations, referral faxes and scheduling.
business_model: B2B SaaS for practices, pricing not public
product_category: Healthcare administrative automation with a voice and workflow AI agent (Annie)

founders.name: JP Montoya
previous_startups: Momentu (employee mental health benefits in Latin America, the company that entered YC S22 before the Solum pivot)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built Solum as the tool he wished he had when scaling his own practice to 20,000 patients. No education or prior employers found on the sources opened.

founders.name: Noam Grebler
previous_startups: Peer-to-peer mental health organization for US college students, started about six years before the Momentu launch post
founders.background_notes: Named with JP Montoya as author of the Momentu YC launch post. Not listed as a Solum founder on the YC page.

competitors.name: Zenda.la
competitors.what: Latin American workplace mental health and wellness benefits startup, a peer of Momentu in the YC launch era
competitors.funding_then: raised 2 million USD on 2021-06-09 per CB Insights comparison page

technical_complexity.rationale: At founding the product was a mental health benefits service with coaching and therapy delivery, mostly operations. The later voice AI and EHR integrations are harder but came after the pivot.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with 40 plus EHR and practice management systems add some lock-in, but AI front office tools are easy to copy and bundled by incumbents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Practice management vendors such as CareCloud and SPRY PT now bundle benefit verification and prior authorization, SPRY PT announcing an AI prior authorization product in 2025-09. No acquisition of Solum found.

market_need_then: Momentu launch post cites that 75 percent of Latin American employees face a mental health challenge while under 25 percent get support. The therapy admin need behind the later Solum product is stated by the company, not independently measured here.

branding.domain_note: Uses getsolum.com, a get prefix, not the exact solum.com

identity.logo: not described in any source opened
identity.mascot_or_character: Annie, the named AI front office agent
identity.voice_and_tone: Practical and outcome focused, built by practice owners for practice owners

rebrands.why: Pivot from employee mental health benefits to AI automation for therapy practices; the YC page now carries the Solum name and lists Momentu only as a launch post. Date approximate from the YC founded year.

brand_strength.rationale: No evidence of community, merch or press about the brand itself. Press coverage is listed by the company only.

pivots.from: Momentu, employee mental health benefits in Latin America
pivots.to: Solum Health, AI automation for therapy practices
pivots.why: Founder says he built the tool he needed for his own practice. Pivot year inferred from the YC page founded 2024, not stated as a pivot.

outcome_analysis: Solum is active with a team of three and named customers in ABA and physical therapy. It entered YC as Momentu in S22 and appears to have pivoted into therapy practice automation about two years later, with the founder drawing on his own practice. Funding beyond YC is not verified, so the stage and runway are unknown. The space is crowded with practice management suites adding AI prior authorization.
notes: Unverified: Caplight lists a seed dated 2022-09-07 with about 500000 USD total, single aggregator, so not recorded as a round. Company site lists investors Y Combinator, Wisdom Ventures, Founders Club, BAM Capital, Liquid2 Ventures, Lionheart Ventures and Rebel Fund without amounts. No shutdown or acquisition news found. Competitor list reflects the Momentu era only, no dated rivals found for the therapy admin product at the 2022 batch.
